end.summary:
Practised standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Identified straight versus curved lines in examples, letters, and objects.
Recognised lines in T, H, A, and L.
Discussed that a straight line can change direction when turned; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised naming standing, sleeping, and slanting lines and finding them in letters and familiar objects. They used visual features such as “up and down,” “flat,” and “slanted,” and correctly identified curved lines as round. There was a mix-up between a line’s direction and whether it is straight, especially with V and a turned line; this was clarified later when Om identified the turned line as straight and sleeping. At home, ask Om to find one example of each line type in letters or objects and explain whether the line is straight or curved.
